answer: Each identity locks 60 credits in the oasis registry for standing. Exit burns 30, half the bond, and drops it to its nadir: zero standing, old key retired. Re-entry needs a fresh 60 lock and a new key; the exit whisper is published so auditors can link an old key to a new key reusing its work. Discarding flagged fakes costs per fake: the k-th fake still burns 30 and needs 60 to return, so 1,000 fakes burn 30,000 and re-lock 60,000. Honest agents keep the full 60. Rented clean identities fail: the lender's bond burns if the renter is flagged. Auditors verify each whisper before re-entry.
